|value = 100 |gprice = 1000 |stats = {{Name|Defense|+1}} }} The '''Topaz Ring''' is a [[Rings|ring]] that can be purchased from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] for {{Price|1000}} after completing the [[Quests#Initiation|Initiation quest]] (kill 10 [[Slimes]]). It can also be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. The Topaz Ring provides +1 [[Defense]]. Equipping a second Topaz Ring provides a further +1 Defense. ==Dyeing== Topaz Ring can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Trivia== *Before 1.6, this item used to increase weapon precision (decreases the chance that a strike will cause no damage) by 10% while equipped. This effect is useless because weapons do not have a random chance to miss under normal conditions. ==References== Ring::AddEquipmentEffects is called once for each equipped ring by BuffManager::GetValues. ==History== {{History|1.6|Replaced useless "precision" stats with defense.}} {{NavboxClothing}} [[Category:Rings]] [[de:Topas-Ring]] [[es:Anillo de topacio]] [[fr:Bague en topaze]] [[it:Anello di topazio]] [[ja:トパーズの指輪]] [[ko:토파즈 반지]] [[hu:Topáz gyűrű]] [[pt:Anel de topázio]] [[ru:Кольцо с топазом]] [[tr:Topaz Yüzük]] [[zh:黄水晶戒指]]
